questions.question: Let's start with a little space travel.
questions.text: Which planet in our solar system is known as the Red Planet?

questions.question: What is hiding behind the tiles?
Everyone answers: a little mental arithmetic.
questions.text: What is 12 multiplied by 8? Type the number on your phone and submit once.

questions.question: Look closely. How many gold stars surround the planet?
questions.answer: Five gold stars. The small white dots are not stars for this question.

questions.question: Everyone answers: what shape surrounds the planet?
questions.answer: An oval / ellipse (the planet's ring). Accept ring.

questions.question: Listen to the first three notes. Does their pitch go up or down?
questions.answer: Up / ascending. The first three notes get higher; the last three get lower.

questions.question: Everyone answers: how many notes are played in this short clip?
questions.answer: Three notes. This segment plays only the descending second half.

questions.question: Watch the moving shapes. What colour is the circle?
questions.answer: Magenta / pink / purple-pink. The square is gold and the triangle is mint green.

questions.question: Everyone answers: which shape has exactly three sides?
One last question. Make it count!
questions.text: How many sides does a hexagon have?
